text: The melody feels mysterious, laced with sadness, bitterness, and regret—yet there’s also a sharp intensity, like something within is rising, ready to fight for its glory

A lot of viewers hate on Sang Ah, and even call her the worst character out of all of them, but to me her actions are understandable, even if they're not good in our eyes. The industry has broken her and molded her into who she is. She has anger and vengeance in her heart. She is willing to step on people to hold her position so she won't be trampled on again.

Yang Mi on the other hand is just evil and corrupt to begin with. 
Taeseob is so ambitious he's willing to use people and turn a blind eye to things to get to the top. 
Jeongwon is a victim of so many people, which also shaped her to become who she is and make the choices she does.

Of course none of them are innocent of their actions, since they can all choose differently, but this is a drama and I'm glad they fight back instead of being trampled on. Too many of us walk away or let people trample on us in real life. Honestly, sometimes we have to in order not to go to jail 😂
